I had a proper poke around and it does what I hoped. I saved a couple of links and they landed in my library marked unread, just like we said. When I tried saving the same link twice it wouldn't let me make a duplicate. Searching works nicely — I found things by a tag with `#`, it didn't care about capitalization, and combining terms and excluding a word both behaved the way I'd want. Marking something read dropped it out of my read-later list but kept it in the library, and archiving a link tucked it away out of my main list and into the archive on its own, without deleting it. The read-later, archive, saved views, import/export, and preferences are all right there in front of me too, and it's got a lovely calm look to it.

This is the app I wanted. I'm really pleased with it — thank you. I know there were a few extras we talked about along the way as "someday" ideas, and I'm happy to leave those for a future round; nothing's missing from what we agreed on for this one.

<FINAL_ACCEPTED>
